core_agents.name: architect
core_agents.role: Spec generation (DB schema, FK relationships, invariants)

capabilities.framework_aware: ✅ Yes (FastAPI, Django, Spring, Go, Node, NestJS)

core_agents.limitations: No GraphQL; no inheritance; limited to 7 entities (empirically tested)
core_agents.error_handling: Timeout at 120s; graceful JSON error response; critic can loop back

core_agents.name: implementer
core_agents.role: File body generation (models, CRUD endpoints, services)
core_agents.limitations: Struggles with complex domain-driven models; needs service-author for business logic; no GraphQL resolvers
core_agents.error_handling: Timeout at 120s; auto_patch fixes common issues; critic loops on test failure

core_agents.name: test-author
core_agents.limitations: Some assertions are shallow (mutation testing catches ~50% fail); no perf tests; no security-specific tests
core_agents.error_handling: Timeout at 120s; critic loops on test failure; no reflexive improvement
improvement_areas: Add parametrized tests for edge cases

core_agents.name: reviewer

capabilities.performance_hints: ✅ Yes (N+1, unbounded queries, sync in async)
capabilities.architectural_review: ⚠️ Medium (checks FK consistency, not DDD depth)

core_agents.limitations: Anti-rationalization gate needed to prevent rubber-stamping; limited to code-level checks (no arch decisions)
core_agents.error_handling: Returns findings JSON; critic decides if LOOP or accept

core_agents.name: doubter
core_agents.limitations: Occasionally agrees with reviewer due to shared training; MAX 2 rounds enforced
core_agents.theater_rate: ~15% of second runs show identical findings (theater detected)
core_agents.error_handling: Theater detection escalates to ESCALATE; no productive third round

core_agents.name: wirer
core_agents.role: Idempotent main.py injection (imports, function calls, factory registration)
core_agents.limitations: Single-file focus (main.py); no complex multi-file orchestration
core_agents.idempotency: ✅ Can be re-run safely (no duplicate imports)
core_agents.error_handling: Backup to .osp.bak before mutation; git-aware for safety

core_agents.name: critic
core_agents.role: Test verdict (pytest parsing, root-cause, loop vs ship decision)
core_agents.limitations: Limited to 3 iterations (safe default but sometimes insufficient); no auto-fix
core_agents.error_handling: Timeout at 120s per loop; ESCALATE on max iterations
improvement_areas: Extend max iterations to 5 for complex schemas
Detect flaky tests (same test fails in loops 1 and 3 but passes in 2)

core_agents.name: service-author
core_agents.role: Service layer generation (business logic, invariants, events, background tasks)
core_agents.limitations: Requires well-defined invariants (weak signal → weak output); no saga/event-sourcing patterns; basic business logic only
core_agents.error_handling: Triggered when invariants exist or intent=auth; optional (not mandatory)

workstream_agents.name: docs-author
workstream_agents.role: Comprehensive docstring generation + drift detection proposals

capabilities.drift_detection: ✅ Yes (compares old docs vs new code)

workstream_agents.accuracy: Good with consistent conventions, works best on schema changes
improvement_areas: Better handling of inconsistent docstring styles

workstream_agents.name: rollback
workstream_agents.role: Git-aware rollback to .osp.bak; commit selection logic
workstream_agents.error_handling: Refuses if working tree dirty; validates .osp.bak exists; git-stashes uncommitted
improvement_areas: Add circuit-breaker to prevent infinite rollback loops

workstream_agents.name: otel-monitor
workstream_agents.role: OTel span context injection; trace attribute capture
improvement_areas: Add model attribute to spans (which agent ran?)

workstream_agents.name: mcp-integrator
workstream_agents.role: Service discovery; MCP service wiring; availability checking

workstream_agents.name: memory-propagator
workstream_agents.role: Curriculum update; pattern mining; learning log refresh
improvement_areas: Add human feedback loop for curriculum tuning

auxiliary_agents.name: extractor
auxiliary_agents.role: Fallback for ambiguous domain model prose (extractor confidence < 0.55)
auxiliary_agents.capability: Recognizes many-to-many, demotes attributes to fields, reuses entities

critical_gaps: Service-author requires well-defined invariants (weak signal → weak output)
Critic loop limited to 3 iterations (sometimes insufficient)
strengths: Clear agent-first principle (agents dispatch via Task tool)
Cost-aware model routing (Haiku for writers, Sonnet for reasoners)
